text:
alana: Heads-up: we're experimenting with a structured routing header `X-RI-Route-Broker` (JSON) to unify routing and quota hints. Need SDK owners to add a tiny opt-in path.

matt: Plan? replace or fall back to `Route-Hint`?

alana: Fallback for now. Broker preferred when present. Canary first.

yara: SDK surface idea: new option `enable_route_broker` default false and param `route_broker` accepts string|object. If string, coerce to {"route": <string>}. Send legacy `Route-Hint` during canary.

matt: Telemetry: emit `sdk.route_broker.sent` with `sdk_name` and `opted_in`. Also emit `sdk.route_broker.coerced` when we coerce string->object. Console wants adoption metric and coercion rate.

ops-bot: Console: we'll add "Broker adoption" gauge and a small "Quota delta" comparison. Need `client_id` in payload (opaque) to join traces. Confirm non-PII.

alana: Confirmed - `client_id` stable per-install, not user data. Server will add `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` (internal) that echoes how the header was parsed to help debugging.

yara: Tests: unit for header serialization, small e2e against debug endpoint. Also emit a single deprecation log on first send so customers see guidance.

matt: Semver: minor bumps. Ship minimal patches: py 1.8.x, go v0.12.x, ts 2.3.x. Add env var `REDWOOD_ENABLE_ROUTE_BROKER` for quick opt-in.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: route-broker v0.1-canary -> infra-canary at 03:30 UTC. Canary config: 5% traffic, 14d window. Rollback triggers: 5xxs > 1.8x OR tenant quota mismatch > 3% during first 30m.

alana: Action items: yara -> SDK PRs + tests, matt -> migration doc & runbook, ops-bot -> telemetry mapping + dashboard tile. Keep PRs tiny.

yara: Will open PRs today with examples for py/ts/go.

matt: I'll draft the migration checklist and support notes.

alana: Thanks, team. Keep messages terse in PRs to speed reviews. :thumbsup:

(End)
